data_policy_contract_notes: The public Token Factory terms apply to the standard API route. Customers can opt out of storage and speculative-decoding processing, but the catalogue does not model customer-specific opt-out state.
residency_notes: The live public catalog assigns each current Base route to eu-north1 (Finland), eu-west2 (France), uk-south1 (United Kingdom), or us-central1 (United States). These are execution placements reported for the public endpoints, not user-selectable residency guarantees.
prompt_training_notes: Nebius Token Factory's public Terms of Service say it collects and processes Inputs and Outputs for training smaller speculative-decoding models, while allowing customers to opt out of storage and that processing.

Complete live first-party Base-flavor route catalog used to reconcile model IDs, lifecycle, regions, modalities, features, quantization, context, and prices with zero unaccounted routes.

Section 7 says Nebius may host, cache, store, and modify Inputs and Outputs and collects/processes them to train smaller speculative-decoding models; customers may opt out. This governs the standard public Token Factory API route.

verification.notes: Verified OpenAI Chat, Responses, and Embeddings transports plus all 30 current Base-flavor routes in the live public catalog. Policy classification is for the standard public Token Factory API route; no Phaseo-specific ZDR opt-out state is assumed.
